name: R-15 Portable
source:
R-15 is about a boy, Taketo Akutagawa, who attends a school for geniuses: Inspiration Academy Private High School. Taketo is a genius novelist and writes erotica. Despite negative perceptions many people have of him, he aims to be at the top of his class and be recognized as the world's greatest writer.

This game mixes visual novel segments with interactive minigames where the player touches the girls.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/R-15_(novel_series)]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
《R-15》講述少年芥川丈途的故事。他就讀於一所專門招收天才的高中——私立閃學園，是一位創作情色小說的天才小說家。儘管許多人對他抱有負面看法，他仍立志成為班上的佼佼者，贏得世界第一作家的認可。

本作結合了視覺小說劇情與可讓玩家觸碰女角色的互動小遊戲。

［摘自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/R-15_(novel_series)]維基百科[/url]］
